name: dsh-ui-font
description: DSH Web GUI font engine + settings page: runtime discovery of every client plugin's styles, declaration-point pick-to-tune selector (design tokens / per-rule px), configurable hotkeys (picker / font size ±1), system font enumeration via sfnt name-table parsing, DSH settings.yaml persistence (with localStorage fallback for older installs and offline reads), manual refresh (no polling).
